tha-ap463:1.1: Jagatidāyakavaggo chacattārīso. XLVII [458. Sālakusumiya.] Parinibbute bhagavati jalajuttamanāmake / āropitamhi citake sālapuppham apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap463:2.1: Satassahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi citapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap463:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sālakusumiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
